name: Observed absence
meaning: A working channel records no event.

name: Missing observation
operation: Retain the prior under our missingness rule.
boundary: State-dependent missingness needs its own model.

name: Counterfactual value
meaning: Actuality is compared with a specified alternative.
operation: Assign value without adding an observation.
boundary: Reference-dependent value is not new evidence.

name: Non-reification
meaning: A useful distinction is not held as intrinsically fixed.
operation: Examine its conditions; retain or revise its use.
boundary: Finite revisability does not measure realizing emptiness.
